tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Check ForgeMesh Anomaly Tracker API health and uptime.

tools.name: anomaly_scan
tools.description: Scan a blockchain for sequence anomalies — unusual patterns of whale movements, exchange flows, bridge activity, and stablecoin mints/burns. Returns a story label, anomaly score (0-100), novelty level, and the peak anomalous symbol window. Costs $0.05 USDC on Base mainnet.

tools.name: token_scan
tools.description: Best-effort anomaly scan for a single token — scores recent transfer patterns for unusual activity and returns source status plus coverage notes. Pass a contract address or well-known symbol. Costs $0.03 USDC on Base mainnet.

token.description: Token contract address (0x...) or symbol: usdt, usdc, weth, wbtc, link, uni, aave, steth, pepe, dai, cbeth, arb

tools.name: whale_alerts
tools.description: Get recent whale movements, CEX inflows/outflows, bridge activity, and stablecoin mints/burns from monitored addresses (Binance, Coinbase, Kraken, OKX, Bybit, major bridges, Tether, Circle). Costs $0.02 USDC on Base mainnet.

tools.name: address_scan
tools.description: Scan any wallet address for anomalous transaction patterns. Classifies each transaction by checking counterparties against known CEX wallets, bridges, and stablecoin issuers. Costs $0.03 USDC on Base mainnet.

tools.name: model_status
tools.description: Get SequenceMiner model health and training stats per chain — training sequence count and last retrain time. Costs $0.01 USDC on Base mainnet.

tools.name: nft_scan
tools.description: Best-effort anomaly scan for an NFT collection — detects sweep accumulation, wash trading patterns, and mint surges, then returns source status plus coverage notes. Pass a contract address. Costs $0.03 USDC on Base mainnet.

token.description: NFT contract address (ERC-721 or ERC-1155), e.g. 0xbc4ca0eda7647a8ab7c2061c2e118a18a936f13d

tools.name: defi_scan
tools.description: Anomaly scan for a DeFi protocol — detects unusual flows through major lending and DEX contracts (Uniswap, Aave, Curve, Compound). Pass a protocol name or contract address. Returns a story label and anomaly score. Costs $0.03 USDC on Base mainnet.

protocol.description: Protocol name (uniswap_v3, uniswap_v3_r2, aave_v3, aave_v2, curve_3pool, compound_v3) or a 0x contract address

tools.name: squawk_alerts
tools.description: Best-effort live global sweep of active aviation emergency squawk codes via OpenSky Network. Returns aircraft currently squawking 7700, 7600, or 7500 with source status and coverage notes. Costs $0.02 USDC on Base mainnet.

tools.name: flight_scan
tools.description: Sequence anomaly analysis for a named airspace region — detects unusual clustering of emergency squawks, rapid descents, or speed anomalies using the SequenceMiner engine. Costs $0.03 USDC on Base mainnet.

tools.name: trending_signal
tools.description: GitHub repos with anomalous star velocity right now — early signals before mainstream discovery. Detects repos going viral (200+ stars/day), overnight explosions, fork surges, and issue floods. Useful for trend hunting, VC scouting, developer tool discovery. Costs $0.02 USDC on Base mainnet.

days.description: Search repos created in the last N days (default: 7)

tools.name: repo_scan
tools.description: Deep anomaly scan for a single GitHub repository — scores star velocity, fork ratio, overnight explosion signals, and issue flood patterns. Returns a story label (e.g. 'Breakout Signal', 'Viral Activity') and anomaly score. Costs $0.03 USDC on Base mainnet.

repo.description: GitHub repo in owner/repo format, e.g. vercel/ai or microsoft/vscode

tools.name: github_watch
tools.description: Watch a GitHub repo's activity stream for anomalous development patterns — commit bursts, force pushes, issue floods, merge rushes, bot takeovers. Returns a story label (e.g. 'History Rewrite', 'Merge Sprint', 'Bot Takeover') and anomaly score. Costs $0.03 USDC on Base mainnet.

repo.description: GitHub repo in owner/repo format, e.g. vercel/ai

tools.name: claude_feature_watch
tools.description: Watch Anthropic/Claude repos for recently merged features — SDK changes, Claude Code updates, new capabilities. Scans anthropic-sdk-python, anthropic-sdk-typescript, claude-code, courses, and anthropic-cookbook. Costs $0.02 USDC on Base mainnet.

tools.name: mempool_anomaly
tools.description: Real-time mempool anomaly score — detects gas spikes, MEV signals, pending whale swaps, contract deploy bursts, and priority fee wars. Designed for 5-second polling. Returns a story label (e.g. 'MEV Attack', 'Gas Surge', 'Priority Fee War') and anomaly score. Costs $0.01 USDC on Base mainnet.

chain.description: Blockchain (default: ethereum). Only Ethereum and Base have RPC mempool access.

tools.name: depeg_monitor
tools.description: Real-time stablecoin depeg detector — monitors USDC, USDT, DAI prices for micro-deviations from $1.00 peg, spread between stables, and volume spikes. Catches depegs before they become crises. Designed for 1-minute polling. Returns a story label (e.g. 'Single Coin Drift', 'Multi-Stablecoin Crisis', 'Depeg Event') and anomaly score. Costs $0.01 USDC on Base mainnet.
